name: Unity
description: Cross-platform game engine for 2D/3D, AR/VR. Uses C# scripting. Massive asset store and community.

name: Unreal Engine
description: AAA-grade engine with Blueprint visual scripting and C++. Photorealistic rendering via Nanite & Lumen.

name: Godot
description: Free open-source engine using GDScript (Python-like). Lightweight and great for 2D, improving 3D.

name: VS Code
description: Lightweight, extensible code editor by Microsoft. Extensions for every language, debugging, Git integration.

name: Git & GitHub
description: Distributed version control system. GitHub adds collaboration, CI/CD, and project hosting.

name: Docker
description: Containerization platform. Package apps with dependencies into portable containers for consistent deployments.

name: Figma
description: Collaborative UI/UX design tool. Design, prototype, and handoff — all in the browser.

name: Webpack
description: Module bundler for JavaScript applications. Transforms, bundles, and optimizes assets for production.

name: Vercel
description: Deployment platform for frontend frameworks. Zero-config deploys, edge functions, and preview URLs.

name: Postman
description: API development platform. Build, test, document, and share APIs with team collaboration features.

name: Blender
description: Free professional 3D modeling, animation, and rendering suite. Used for game assets and VFX.

name: Construct 3
description: No-code 2D game engine in the browser. Event-sheet logic makes it perfect for beginners and rapid prototyping.
